_meta.classification_rule: SAFE_AUTOFILL = exact known answer. GENERATE_GROUNDED = open-ended, drafted from the inventory and grounding-checked. NEEDS_REVIEW = legally meaningful, identity-related, or unsupported — a human answers these, never the model.

experience_summary._inferred: years_data_science_ml is inferred from title history; reasonable people could count it as 4.

voluntary_self_identification._note: Decline-by-default. Never auto-filled with a guess, never LLM-generated.
